requirement: An import paces its engine calls about a second apart, honours Retry-After, reads 5000 rows a page, and a host that starts refusing Tracy's connection partway through stops the run as blocked_by_host after three refusals, with a sentence that asks to retry in a few hours, then contact Tracy support, and names no address

oracle.ref: PR #1484 (fix); fix evidence: Before the fix an import fired engine calls back to back with 2000-row pages and ignored Retry-After; a host firewall that started refusing Tracy's connection partway through was retried down the whole ladder, then read as a lost connection, and the next attempt's refused sign-in read as a wrong address. This case pins the behaviour with the tests below.
oracle.invariant: Exit code 0 and `# fail 0`. Pacing (site-link-pacing): consecutive engine calls are at least a second apart and db.dump asks for 5000 rows; a 503 or 429 with Retry-After (seconds or an HTTP date) makes the next call wait that long, capped, and an unreadable value is ignored; (export-site-limits) a site that fails above a page size still halves the page until it fits and the dump is whole. Ban (site-link-pacing): once the site has answered in the run, three consecutive refused connections stop it as blocked_by_host with check connection_refused_after_progress, not the whole retry ladder; refusals at every address (an AggregateError cause) count the same; a refusal before the site ever answered keeps the old path; one refusal followed by answers is a blip and the dump completes. Ban memory (site-link-pacing): after a ban, the next run's sign-in page refused, plain or at every address, on WordPress and Joomla, is blocked_by_host with check connection_refused_after_ban and no new sign-in; without an earlier ban the same refusal is still unreachable. One reading of a fetch error (site-link-pacing): the diagnostic's error code and the Joomla TLS check look inside an AggregateError too. No address (site-link-pacing): no run state, refusal, diagnostic or customer sentence carries an IPv4 or IPv6 address; the English sentence says the host refused partway through, then to try the import again in a few hours, then to contact Tracy support, and promises no resume. Closed sets (beta-operation-signal): the web accepts the two new diagnostic checks, the same set the worker writes.
